findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: glim_twitter_search, glim_twitter_get, glim_reddit_search, glim_reddit_get, glim_web_search, glim_web_fetch, glim_github_search, glim_github_get, glim_amazon_search, glim_amazon_get, glim_youtube_get, glim_detect_ai, glim_telegram_search, glim_telegram_get · Private data: glim_github_search, glim_github_get, glim_youtube_get, glim_telegram_get · Public sink: glim_twitter_get, glim_reddit_search, glim_reddit_get, glim_web_fetch, glim_telegram_search, glim_telegram_get · Destructive: glim_twitter_search, glim_twitter_get, glim_reddit_search, glim_web_search, glim_github_search, glim_amazon_search, glim_amazon_get, glim_youtube_get, glim_detect_ai.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
